summary: Tunisian, residing in the UAE, graduate student in Electrical Engineering, interested in Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies, game hacking enthusiast, engaged in circuit design and hardware/software co-design, strong belief in the potential of Bitcoin for financial freedom in developing countries, critical of Western media narratives, identifies as Muslim, values ethical behavior in academia, actively participates in tech communities, follows developments in programming languages like Scala and Elixir, interested in open-source software, has experience with embedded systems and FPGA technology, concerned about political and social issues affecting Muslims globally.
